name: hantavirus
remarks: Andes Virus (ANDV) / Hantavirus Cardiopulmonary Syndrome (HCPS)
This is the entry-point module for Andes virus disease. It gates population-level
prevalence, then delegates to five submodules under andv/ for the full clinical pathway.
Design notes:
- Synthea is not an epidemic spread engine. This module seeds individual exposure
probabilistically. For cluster/outbreak modeling, an external scenario engine
should set andv_exposed=true on target patients and this module routes accordingly.
- Prevalence gate (0.5%) is a tunable scenario prior, not an empiric constant.
Real endemic-area incidence is much lower; adjust for outbreak scenarios.
- Human-to-human transmission (rare, cluster-capable) is modeled in andv_exposure.
References:
- WHO 2026 DON601 Andes virus cruise-associated cluster
- CDC Hantavirus/Andes virus guidance (2026)
- PAHO hantavirus epidemiological alert 2025
- Design brief: Designing a Synthea Module for Andes Virus Outbreaks (2026)
Hantavirus can infect any age. Guard on age >=1 to avoid neonatal period.
After passing, probabilistically seed exposure at ~0.5% of patients.

0.5% prevalence gate for general population runs.
